verdict.rationale: Trivy is an official CLI that runs non-interactively with commands like `trivy image` and `trivy k8s --report summary cluster`, and it ships as a `docker run aquasec/trivy` container, so it suits headless automation. Community users independently report using it in CI and call it 'super easy to integrate in every ci/cd pipeline' and 'very easy to write automation around'. Missing for 10: first-party CI integration docs (e.g. pipeline examples, exit-code behavior for failing builds) and documented machine-readable output formats for automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: it's super easy to integrate in every ci/cd pipeline
very easy to write automation around
we only use it in our CI and this covers our requirements
